audit.why: Both layers grade all seven stages Skill and the content whys argue for a knife-edge lane throughout, which matches the 46.09% over 128 games — the largest sample in the slice. No stage contradicts its own side here.

audit.whatIsWrong: Quickdraw is treated as the clock the whole lane runs on, in the win condition, the cooldown block, both do's, the don'ts and the interactions report. dosFull[2] also called a whiffed Quickdraw a "fifteen-second invitation".
audit.why: Quickdraw is 16/15/14/13/12s, but Riot's description adds that "hitting enemies with basic attacks lowers the cooldown of this skill" — so in a lane where he is auto-attacking constantly it is rarely a real window. Smoke Screen at 26/24/22/20/18s is the genuinely long cooldown, and it is the ability that decides trades by cutting your sight range.
audit.corrected: Smoke Screen's 26s is now named as the actual punish window in the win condition and the cooldown block, Quickdraw's 16s is stated with its auto-attack refund so the reader stops counting it as fixed, and the fifteen-second figure is corrected.

audit.whatIsWrong: Armour stacking is attributed to "New Destiny" in three strings (spikes[0], wants.foe[0], whys[1]). New Destiny's own blocking property — the single most exploitable thing about Graves — appears nowhere, and neither does Comeuppance's minion block.
audit.why: New Destiny is the shotgun passive: "Attacks fire 4 bullets, which cannot pass through units." The armour and magic resist come from True Grit on Quickdraw. So the page credits the wrong ability for his tankiness while omitting that a single minion standing between you and Graves eats his entire auto-attack. That is a positioning rule that changes every trade. The mirror of it also matters: Comeuppance stops on the first champion, minion or structure hit, so the same wave that protects you blocks your ultimate.
audit.corrected: True Grit is credited correctly in all three places, New Destiny's minion block is written into wants.you[0] and the early text, and Comeuppance's minion block is now in the Level 6 stage.

edits.before: Out-angle the poke war and execute the chip with R. Quickdraw is the clock this lane runs on — read it before every step forward.
edits.after: Out-angle the poke war and execute the chip with R. Smoke Screen is 26s — that downtime, not Quickdraw, is your window.

edits.before: Graves wins by landing Quickdraw, denying your pattern, and out-ranging your plan one polite trade at a time.
edits.after: Graves wins by smoke-screening your sightline, stacking True Grit, and out-shotgunning you at his own range.

edits.before: Comeuppance online — the lock-on execute closes everything you chip. Scoundrels die; teammates revive.
edits.after: Comeuppance online, but it stops on the first minion — clear the line, then execute what you chipped.

edits.before: You can win short swing trades here, but a mistimed step into his Smoke Screen slows you and blanks your vision — fight only on your angle.
edits.after: Smoke Screen is 26s at rank 1, so its downtime is your real window — step into the cloud and you're slowed and half-blind while he picks the angle.

edits.before: Respect his level 1 — his loaded shotgun auto plus End of the Line out-bursts your single passive shot, so don't contest at melee. You get a real window at 2-3: the second passive shot lands, Q pokes on the way out, and E at 3 lets you swing for an angle and bail. But keep it to one Q-and-leave — his New Destiny passive stacks armor as he fights and blunts your physical poke, and if he steps up with a full shotgun you lose the flat trade. Don't sit in his Smoke Screen either; the cloud slows you and cuts your vision out of it, so he picks the angle and you can't see his step-back.
edits.after: Respect his level 1 — his loaded shotgun auto plus End of the Line out-bursts your single passive shot, so don't contest at melee. You get a real window at 2-3: the second passive shot lands, Q pokes on the way out, and E at 3 lets you swing for an angle and bail. Keep it to one Q-and-leave — Quickdraw's True Grit stacks resists as he fights and blunts your poke. Use the wave: New Destiny fires four bullets that cannot pass through units, so a minion between you eats his autos outright. Don't sit in his Smoke Screen either; it's 26s at rank 1, and the cloud slows you and cuts your vision.
